plan.title: Add 'Extension Points' sections to system docs
plan.overview: Add an Extension Points section template to engineering-system.md that guides developers on how to extend systems with new components. Each extension point subsection documents: template file to copy, checklist of files to modify, and common pitfalls. Update docs-engineering.md skill guidance to explain how to identify and document extension points.

approach.rationale:
The existing engineering-system.md template (lines 79-91) ends with Configuration section. The Extension Points section fits naturally after Boundaries (line 83) to follow the pattern of "what it does NOT do" followed by "how to extend it".
Following the existing section structure pattern: header with brief intro, then structured content (tables, code blocks, or subsections). Extension points will use subsections per component type with standardized content.
The docs-engineering.md skill guidance (lines 99-124) already has "For Systems" section showing required sections. Extension Points guidance will be added there to explain when and how to document extension points.

task.name: Add Extension Points section template to engineering-system.md
task.action:
- Add new "## Extension Points" section after Configuration (line 91) - Add introductory text explaining what this section covers - Add subsection template "### Adding a new {ComponentType}" with placeholders - Include three subsection elements: 1. **Template file:** with placeholder for file path 2. **Checklist:** with bulleted list of files to modify 3. **Pitfalls:** with bulleted list of common mistakes - Include example showing the pattern (e.g., "### Adding a new Capability")
Current structure (line 79-91): ```markdown ## Boundaries
What this system does NOT handle:
- **Does NOT:** {thing} → See [{system}](../{system}/_index.md) - **Does NOT:** {thing}
## Configuration
| Setting | Description | Default | |---------|-------------|---------| | {setting} | {what it does} | {default} | ```
Add after Configuration: ```markdown ## Extension Points
How to extend this system with new components:
### Adding a new {ComponentType}
**Template:** Copy `{path/to/template.ts}` as starting point.
**Checklist:** - [ ] Create component file following naming convention - [ ] Register in {orchestrator or entry point} - [ ] Add to {config file if needed} - [ ] {Additional registration steps}
**Pitfalls:** - {Common mistake 1} - {Common mistake 2} ```

task.name: Add Extension Points guidance to docs-engineering.md
task.action:
- Locate the "#### For Systems" section (lines 99-124) - Add "## Extension Points" to the required sections list (after Boundaries) - Add a new subsection explaining how to identify and document extension points - Include guidance on: 1. How to identify extension points (component types that can be added) 2. How to find template files 3. How to determine the registration checklist 4. How to identify common pitfalls - Include example of well-written extension point documentation
Current "For Systems" section (lines 99-124): ```markdown #### For Systems
```markdown ## Architecture - High-level design ...
## Boundaries - What this system does NOT do - Limitations - Related systems ``` ```
Add to the list after Boundaries: ```markdown ## Extension Points - How to add new components - Template files to copy - Registration checklists - Common pitfalls ```
Add new guidance section after "For Systems": ```markdown #### Extension Points (Systems Only)
When documenting systems, identify extension points - component types that can be added:
**How to identify extension points:** 1. Look for component directories (e.g., capabilities/, computers/, orchestrators/) 2. Check for repeated patterns (multiple files with same structure) 3. Note registration points (entry file imports, config files)
**How to document each extension point:** 1. **Template:** Find a representative existing file to use as template 2. **Checklist:** Trace the registration flow from component to entry point 3. **Pitfalls:** Review PRs or code comments for common issues
**Example:** ```markdown ### Adding a new Capability
**Template:** Copy `capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts`
**Checklist:** - [ ] Create `{name}.capability.ts` in `src/capabilities/` - [ ] Add factory function with dependencies parameter - [ ] Wire into domain orchestrator that owns this concern - [ ] Add TreeView contribution to package.json if TreeView capability
**Pitfalls:** - Don't import other capabilities (lateral dependency forbidden) - Don't put policy logic (ensure*, getOrCreate*) in capabilities ``` ```
task.done: docs-engineering.md explains how to identify and document extension points with examples
